crossRefs.note: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.
You shall take a bunch of hyssop, and dip it in the blood that is in the basin, and strike the lintel and the two door…
Moses came and told the people all Yahweh’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice…
how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse…
According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

translations.web: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.
translations.bsb: That is why even the first covenant was not put into effect without blood.
translations.kjv: Whereupon neither the first testament was dedicated without blood.
translations.asv: Wherefore even the first covenant hath not been dedicated without blood.
